'''Sirloss Brill''' was a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who raised [[laca]] herds on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makthierse]] with his brother, [[Tovi Brill|Tovi]]. Initially they set up in the [[Quantrax Creek]] region, but the herd was preyed on by [[preying makthier]]s. Brill and his brother subsequently moved the herd north.<ref name="COG" />
